operations.summary: List operations in an explicit tenant scope
operations.description: The cursor freezes the set of operations whose committed creation audit position is at or below the first page watermark. Mutable state, progress, and update/completion timestamps remain live on later pages.

params.name: scope_id
params.description: Explicit active tenant scope; platform scope is never implied.

params.name: cursor
params.description: HMAC-authenticated cursor bound to scope, filters, and a committed creation-audit watermark. It freezes membership, not mutable operation state or progress.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Non-disclosing filter within the effective tenant scope. A foreign or nonexistent UUID returns the same 200 response with an empty items array.

params.name: site_display_id
params.description: Tenant-scoped stable positive site identifier displayed by the UI.

params.name: search
params.description: Exact operation/site short ID or a case-insensitive target URL fragment.

params.name: state
params.description: One state or several, comma separated (any of them).

responses.description: Stable operation page.

fields.name: state_counts
fields.description: First page only. Operations per state under every filter but state.

responses.description: Invalid or non-canonical request.
Authentication required.
Exact cache permission is absent or route audience is wrong.
Request context was cancelled or exceeded its deadline.
A required store is unavailable; raw dependency errors are never returned.

params.name: scope_id
params.description: Explicit active tenant scope; platform scope is never implied.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: Edge cachetask schema v2 wire envelope. At most 16 targets, each at most 16 KiB of UTF-8 bytes, with at most 64 KiB of raw target bytes across the array. The aggregate byte limit is enforced by the server in addition to this JSON Schema.

responses.description: Durable operation accepted in queued state; no delivery is implied.

fields.name: state
fields.type: string: queued / running / succeeded / partial_failed / failed / cancelled

fields.name: auto_nodes
fields.description: Created without node_ids (every carrying node); otherwise nodes are the nodes it named.

operations.summary: Re-submit an operation as a new one
operations.description: Creates a new operation with the original's site, action, target type, targets and retry budget, on the nodes the original named, or on every node carrying the site now when it named none (auto_nodes). The Idempotency-Key is the batch key: with the original operation it forms the new operation's idempotency key, so a retry of one batch replays (Idempotency-Replayed) and another batch creates another operation. Audited as cache.operation.resubmit on the original operation.
